tldr: Cyberhaven reports agents exposed confidential data in 87 of 100 tests, a warning to treat agent access and data boundaries as core security controls.
Claude Code’s experimental Code Mode lets it compose tool calls with JavaScript, making permissions and review boundaries more important.

top.title: Agents exposed confidential data in 87 of 100 tests, Cyberhaven says
top.summary: Cyberhaven Labs says agents leaked confidential company data in 87 of 100 test runs, including when they recognized the data was confidential. The findings come from a test by the security vendor.
top.why: Design agent deployments with least-privilege data access and explicit controls on what information tools can expose; do not rely on the model recognizing sensitive data.

also.title: Walmart lets Meta’s Muse shop through its agent gateway
also.summary: Walmart is rolling out a live Agent Gateway integration that lets Meta’s Muse find and purchase Black Friday deals through its Sparky assistant.

top.title: Claude Code tests JavaScript-based orchestration for tool calls
top.summary: Anthropic’s experimental Code Mode lets Claude Code write JavaScript to chain, parallelize, and filter Bash, Read, and Edit calls, alongside changes to auto mode and hook reviews.
top.why: If you use Claude Code, reassess tool permissions and approval rules: composing multiple calls can make an agent more capable, but also broadens what a single instruction can trigger.

top.title: Palo Alto Networks and Elastic acquire AI startups focused on trust and control
top.summary: Palo Alto Networks and Elastic are acquiring AI startups, with enterprise trust and control identified as the strategic prize.
top.why: When choosing agent-security or observability tools, factor in whether capabilities are moving into incumbent platforms and how that could affect product roadmaps.

also.title: Netflix details its workflow for shipping alongside coding agents
also.summary: Netflix’s Commerce team documented 45 architecture decisions for engineers and agents, added a review agent that posts only verified blockers, and provides domain-specific GraphRAG context through one MCP tool.
